about.title: About Me
about.bio1: I'm a Full-Stack Developer with over 3 years of experience building enterprise web applications for government agencies and private sector clients in Thailand.
about.bio2: I specialize in backend development, REST API design, and SQL Server database architecture — delivering complete systems from server infrastructure to production-ready UI.
about.bio3: I've worked across the full SDLC: gathering requirements onsite, designing system architecture, setting up CI/CD pipelines, performing security testing with OWASP ZAP, integrating message queues with RabbitMQ, and writing technical documentation. I'm equally comfortable writing complex SQL stored procedures, configuring Windows Server + IIS, or building responsive frontends with Vue/Nuxt/TypeScript.
about.bio4: Currently at Adasoft Co., Ltd., I help maintain a large-scale POS system and am developing a new system using Next.js and NestJS.
about.bio5: I am highly passionate about AI-assisted development, constantly exploring and integrating new AI tools into my workflow. Since the early days of ChatGPT-3, I have actively used and adapted to platforms like Gemini, GitHub Copilot, Tabnine, Kiro, and Antigravity to maximize productivity, accelerate problem-solving, and deliver high-quality code faster.

pos.title: Large-Scale POS System
pos.subtitle: Enterprise Retail Platform
pos.problem: A large-scale POS system with growing complexity across inventory, product management, tax invoicing (E-Tax), and external data interfaces. The codebase used legacy patterns causing slow feature delivery and fragile integrations.
pos.solution: Maintained and extended the system using CodeIgniter 3 HMVC architecture, implementing clean module boundaries. Developed complex SQL stored procedures for document numbering and financial reporting. Simultaneously designed the next-generation architecture in Next.js + NestJS with a scalable module structure and role-based menu permission system.

impact.1: Stabilized a critical production system serving multiple retail locations
impact.2: Delivered full E-Tax (electronic tax invoice) module from scratch
impact.3: Architectural blueprint ready for migration to Next.js + NestJS
impact.4: Reduced integration issues through clear API contracts with external C# teams

mqDashboard.title: MQ Monitoring Dashboard
mqDashboard.subtitle: Internal DevOps Tool
mqDashboard.problem: The team was losing hours every week manually restarting message queue consumers and had no visibility into queue depth or consumer health. Every failure required SSH access to the server and manual intervention.
mqDashboard.solution: Designed and built a web-based MQ Monitoring Dashboard using Python (queue consumer logic) and Laravel (web interface). The dashboard displays real-time queue status, message counts, and consumer states — allowing any team member to restart services, clear queues, or inspect messages directly from a browser.

impact.1: Eliminated repeated manual server restarts — self-service via web UI
impact.2: Reduced monitoring overhead from hours per week to minutes
impact.3: Improved team visibility into RabbitMQ consumer health in real time
impact.4: Non-technical team members can now diagnose and recover queue issues independently

cicd.title: Jenkins CI/CD Pipeline Setup
cicd.subtitle: Automated Deployment Infrastructure
cicd.problem: Deployments were done manually by developers SSHing into servers, copying files, and restarting services. This was error-prone, undocumented, required senior developer involvement, and made rollbacks difficult.
cicd.solution: Configured Jenkins CI/CD from scratch, setting up multi-stage pipelines with GitHub Webhooks for automated triggering. Deployments now run automatically on push to the appropriate branch, with configurable build steps, environment variable injection, and post-deploy health checks.

impact.1: Replaced manual deployments with fully automated pipelines
impact.2: Cut deployment time from 30+ minutes (manual) to under 5 minutes
impact.3: Enabled the entire team to deploy confidently without senior oversight
impact.4: Improved deployment frequency and reduced human error risk
